title: Rename build_symbols.extract to extract_symbols
body: `devkb/build_symbols.py` defines `extract(root)`, and many other modules also define a function called `extract`, which makes the call sites hard to tell apart. Rename the one in `devkb/build_symbols.py` to `extract_symbols`, and update every place that calls or imports **that** function (code, tests and benchmarks). Do not rename or touch any other function named `extract`.
